text: Live feeds cache in localStorage with a TTL, rate-limit network attempts, back off after failures and survive broken storage.
USGS Bay Area quakes within 100 km parse; every one is listed, but only a new quake of magnitude 2.5 or more during a session shakes the camera, toasts and grants the rare card once.
OpenSky traffic parses; when blocked, simulated SFO and OAK arrivals and departures fly the real runways and 3 degree glide paths, with nav lights and close-call warnings.
Baked GTFS shapes animate cable cars, the F-line, Muni buses and ferries on their real timetables synced to SF time.
NOAA tide predictions parse; the offline harmonic model matches NOAA highs and lows within 5 cm and 10 minutes.
The Live SF panel shows every feed's status, the weather, the latest quake, nearby planes, the next cable car and the tides.
